After a successful 2025 pilot, we’re excited to continue our partnership with Reichman University - International School!

International couples can once again enjoy discounted tuition for Intensive Summer Ulpan, now with a simplified registration process for partner visa holders. This is one of the best (and fastest!) ways to learn Hebrew and integrate into Israeli society. 📚

Courses at all levels are starting this month – apply now to secure your spot! Link in the comments 👇
